description: Canonical review log for System Requests. Slack may carry the discussion or notification, but this file is the only source of truth for a decision. No request is executed merely because it appears here.

decision_contract.approval_effect: APPROVED permits creation of an intervention or data-work proposal; it does not authorize customer outreach, external data pulls, or product changes by itself.
decision_contract.slack_rule: Slack is notification and discussion only. An explicit owner decision must be recorded here before system state changes.
